question.text: What will be current through the $200 \Omega$ resistor in the given circuit, a long time after the switch $K$ is made on?

solution.text: In steady state, arm having capacitors does not flow current. So, we can neglect them. $\therefore$ The given circuit reduces to $$ R_{\text {net }}=200+400=600 \Omega $$ $\therefore$ Current in circuit, $$ \begin{aligned} I=\frac{V}{R} &=\frac{6}{600}=0.01 \mathrm{A} \\ &=10 \mathrm{mA} \end{aligned} $$
